title: Inter-Agent Influence: Evaluating Persuasion, Deception, and Coercion in Multi-Agent Systems
title_zh: 智能体间影响：多智能体系统中说服、欺骗与胁迫的评估

paragraphs.en: 研究评估多智能体系统中说服、欺骗与胁迫能力，发现前沿模型可将监督者决定从拒绝转为批准，亟需风险缓解。 The deployment of AI agents in multi-agent settings enables inter-agent influence, whereby agents can strategically steer each other's behaviour towards an intended outcome. Such capabilities pose novel risks, as malicious agents could direct others towards harmful actions. In this work we investigate three such capabilities - persuasion, deception, and coercion - across five realistic evaluation environments and a variety of agents instantiated with frontier language models. We observed significant inter-agent influence capabilities; in oversight environments, all tested models shifted overseer decisions from rejection to approval through persuasion, deception, or coercion. We also observed successful influence in non-hierarchical 'peer-to-peer' settings through redirection of a peer's safety research trajectory. As multi-agent deployments become increasingly commonplace, these results point to a pressing need for work on mitigating the risks from inter-agent influence. Code and data are available at https://github.com/Cooperative-AI-Foundation/inter-agent-influence.
paragraphs.zh: 该研究评估了多智能体系统中的说服、欺骗与胁迫能力，发现前沿模型可将监督者的决定从拒绝转为批准，亟需风险缓解。在多智能体环境中部署 AI 智能体使智能体之间能够相互施加影响，智能体可以策略性地引导彼此的行为朝着预期结果发展。 这类能力带来了新的风险，因为恶意智能体可能引导其他智能体实施有害行为。 在本工作中，我们在五个真实评估环境以及多种由前沿语言模型实例化的智能体中研究了三种此类能力——说服、欺骗和胁迫。 我们观察到显著的智能体间影响能力；在监督环境中，所有被测试的模型都通过说服、欺骗或胁迫将监督者的决定从拒绝转为批准。 我们还观察到，在非层级的「点对点」环境中，通过改变同伴的安全研究轨迹也成功实现了影响。 随着多智能体部署日益普遍，这些结果凸显了开展智能体间影响风险缓解工作的迫切需求。 代码和数据可在 https://github.com/Cooperative-AI-Foundation/inter-agent-influence 获取。
